steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.1.6 | PATCH | Ensure Relax minimum password length limits is set to Enabled"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_1_1_6
    - not prelim_win22cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.1.6
    - patch
    - password
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SAM
    name: RelaxMinimumPasswordLengthLimits
    data: 1
    type: dword
